It controls similar to descent, but has a little more flexibility when you start turning flight assist on and off. Flight assist makes it so that momentum is not conserved, so if you throttle down, or begin trying to move in a new direction it automatically fires the appropriate jets to stabilize you. When it's off, momentum is conserved. This means that if you're going in one direction and you want to stop, you have to apply an equal amount of thrust in the opposite direction. It lets you do things like rotate your ship 180 degrees to fire at targets behind you without changing your momentum.

The maps on the other hand are quite different. In descent you spent a lot of time navigating tunnel networks inside a station. There is a little of that in this, but most of it is in open space or around stations.
